_readme: Reviewed daily price moves above 20%. The price-jump check flags every such move and marks
the stock as needing review until the date is listed here.
kind 'real_move': a genuine market move (a crash, a news day). Kept as it is.
kind 'demerger': the price stepped down because part of the company was split off.
kind 'bonus': the price stepped down because of a bonus issue or split that the data source
did not carry back through its history.
For 'demerger' and 'bonus' the engine scales the earlier prices by the size of the step when
it loads history, so indicators and backtests see one continuous series.
Each entry is a claim someone checked. Add the date the step appears in OUR stored data (IST)

ETERNAL.note: New-age tech sell-off; Zomato fell with the sector.

ADANIENT.note: Hindenburg sell-off; FPO withdrawn that evening.

KAYNES.note: Fell about 19% after Q4 FY26 results missed estimates; previous close Rs 4,177.85. Checked against news reports of that day.

TMPV.note: Tata Motors demerger of the commercial-vehicle business; 14 Oct 2025 was the record date.

VEDL.note: Vedanta demerger (-64.9%). Reviewed in the July 2026 rebuild; not adjusted by the data source.

TRENT.note: 1-for-2 bonus issue, ex-date 2026-06-04 (ratio exactly 1.5). The data source adjusted its prices for the bonus only back to 2026-01-01, so the step appears on that date in stored history. Still present after a full re-download on 2026-11-19.
